source.attribution: Inneholder data under Norsk lisens for offentlige data (NLOD) tilgjengeliggjort av Brønnøysundregistrene.

access.note: Public endpoint returns person names + full birth date. The fødselsnummer (national ID) is NOT here — that requires the authenticated autorisert-api (Maskinporten), which is out of scope.

pagination.note: One request per organisation number: /enheter/{orgnr}/roller. No open roles bulk file.

incremental_feed.note: Delta feed of entities whose roles changed; also /api/roller/totalbestand where available.

transport.rate_limit: unknown; per-orgnr fetch — throttle and only fetch entities of interest

snapshot.pii_handling: Redact or minimize person.navn and person.fodselsdato before persisting outside raw zone; consider birth-year-only; keep PII out of fixtures.

parsing.notes: Each role is a discriminated union: person XOR enhet. Filter fratraadt/avregistrert for current officers. valgtAv marks how a board member was elected (e.g. AREP employee rep).

mapping_rules.officers: Flatten rollegrupper[].roller[] into officer entries with role code, role description, holder (person or company), elected_by, resigned.
mapping_rules.auditor: rollegrupper where type.kode=REVI; holder is usually an enhet (audit firm) — join to brregenhet.
mapping_rules.board: rollegrupper where type.kode=STYR (LEDE chair, MEDL member, VARA deputy).

fixture_requirements: entity with DAGL + STYR (chair, members, deputies, employee reps) + REVI
role held by a company (enhet, e.g. auditor) vs a person
REDACTED fixtures only — no real person names or birth dates

live_test_plan.smoke: GET /enheter/{orgnr}/roller for a known AS/ASA; assert rollegrupper contains DAGL/STYR/REVI and person XOR enhet per role.
live_test_plan.full: Iterate roles only for the entity set of interest via the oppdateringer/roller delta feed; gate behind env flag; apply PII minimization on persist.

blockers: PII/GDPR: lawful basis and retention policy required before persisting person names/birth dates beyond the raw zone.
